title: Brauer pullback along finite modifications of reduced curves
statement:
Let $k$ be algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure], and let $f:C	o\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a curve [def-sc-curves] which is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. Let $Y$ be a scheme and $
u:Y	o C$ a finite morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. Let $V\subseteq C$ be a dense open such that $
u^{-1}(V)	o V$ is an isomorphism. Then canonical pullback
$$H^2(C_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,C})\longrightarrow H^2(Y_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf G_{m,Y})$$
is injective [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-br]. The map is cohomology pullback to $
u^*\mathbf G_{m,C}$ followed by $
u^*\mathbf G_{m,C}	o\mathbf G_{m,Y}$. No smoothness, reducedness or connectedness is imposed on $Y$, and properness of $C$ is not required.

proof.text: Use dense_open_finite_complement to obtain finiteness, closedness of points, and separably closed residue fields of C minus V. The units comparison on the isomorphism locus shows that φ = gmSheafToLowerStarGmSheaf ν is an isomorphism after inverse image along V inclusion.

Apply bijective_H_map_of_isIso_upperStar_map to φ in degree 0+2. Its injective part gives injectivity from H²(C,G_m) to H²(C,ν_*G_m). This packages kernel and cokernel acyclicity and avoids proving that φ itself is a monomorphism. The unit route is unchanged.

Compose with the injective part of bijective_edgeMap_of_isFinite ν Y.gmSheaf 2. Rewrite by cohomologyMap_map. Unfold upperStarGmSheafToGmSheaf using Adjunction.homEquiv_counit and apply H.map_comp_apply. The composite is exactly the canonical pullback in the unchanged target statement.
